# U59: Workspace opens on About: one line under the title, the facts each leading to their section, nothing about another workspace; a member sees the same facts with whom to ask and nothing to sort out, and an admins’ section says who the admins are; on a phone About comes first, then the other sections

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `WORKSPACE-ABOUT`, `WORKSPACE-SECTIONS`
- **Budget:** at most 8 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U59

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The menu (the sidebar on a computer, the tab bar on a phone) shows.
- If `phone`:
  - **Step.** Press the “More” button in the phone’s tab bar.
  - **Step.** Press the “Workspace” link in a dialog.
- Otherwise:
  - **Step.** Press the “Workspace” link in the sidebar.
- **Check:** The workspace facts shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the dt in the ws facts (`.ws-facts dt`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `line === 'Platform Engineering · you’re an admin here' && !/permissions|stays in this browser/i.test(head)`, where `const line = await p.locator('.ws-role-line').innerText()`; `const head = await p.locator('.page-head').first().innerText()`. Else it says: the header says “{head.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}”.
- _Note:_ Each fact links to its section; nothing on About is about another workspace.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `want.every((w) => links.includes(w))`, where `const links = await p.locator('.ws-facts a').evaluateAll((as) => as.map((a) => new URL(a.href).pathname.replace(/^\/demo/, '')))`; `const want = ['/people', '/workspace/cycles', '/workspace/access', '/workspace/features', '/workspace/privacy']`. Else it says: About’s facts link to {links.join(', ')}.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `foreign === 0 && await p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Every section' }).count() === 0`, where `const foreign = await p.locator('main').getByRole('link', { name: /Try it with your own team|Set up a workspace|Try the demo/ }).count() + await p.locator('main').getByRole('button', { name: /Reset the example|Leave this workspace/ }).count()`. Else it says: About has {foreign} buttons about another workspace, or an “Every section” list.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “about”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ On a phone, About comes first and the other sections follow; a section opens with Workspace to go back to.
- If `phone`:
  - **Check:** The “Workspace sections” list shows.
  - **Check:** (`progress`) met when `factsTop < moreTop`, where `const more = p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Workspace sections' })`; `const factsTop = await p.locator('.ws-facts').evaluate((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY)`; `const moreTop = await more.evaluate((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY)`. Else it says: on a phone the sections come before About.
  - **Step.** Press the “Privacy” link in the “Workspace sections” list.
  - **Check:** The “Workspace” link shows.
- _Note:_ A member: the same facts, whom to ask, nothing to sort out; Access's address says who the admins are.
- Switch to Rhea in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- **Check:** The workspace facts shows.
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Access is for admins. The admins here are Amara Nwosu, Grace Achterberg and Hamid Rezaei.” is shown.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `/Ask one of them to add someone, change a team or change a setting\./.test(facts) && !sortOut && told`, where `const facts = await p.locator('.ws-facts').innerText()`; `const sortOut = await p.getByRole('heading', { name: /To sort out/ }).count()`; `const told = await see(p, 'Access is for admins. The admins here are Amara Nwosu, Grace Achterberg and Hamid Rezaei.').then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: a member’s About: “{facts.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 200)}”, to sort out {sortOut}, Access told {told}.
- Close this browser.
